title: Pyaasa
blurb: Guru Dutt's poet at the edge of the city. A print about longing, neon dusk, and the walk home.

title: Jaane Bhi Do Yaaron
blurb: A city comedy that turns into a crime farce. Friends, a corpse, and a joke that never quite ends.

title: Karan arjun
blurb: Reincarnation, revenge, and two brothers who refuse to stay dead. Drawn like a myth you already know.

title: Baazigar
blurb: A romance that is also a trap. Charm on the surface, a long game underneath.

title: Khoon Bhari Mang
blurb: A widow returns, and the revenge is theatrical. Crocodile, sun, and a story that will not stay buried.

title: Mr India
blurb: Invisibility as a children's adventure and a national daydream. Clock, rainbow, and the man who isn't there.

title: Shaan
blurb: A caper with a crocodile and a shark on a leash. Spectacle first, then the punchline.

title: ZNMD
blurb: Three friends, a goat, a plane, and the joke of starting over. A holiday that is also a midlife dare.

title: Baadshah
blurb: Gadgets, disguises, and a spy who never quite grows up. Green panels like a comic you can hang.

title: Dangal
blurb: A father, two daughters, and a clock that will not stop. Wrestling drawn as family legend.

title: Bathroom
blurb: A private room made public. Tiles, plumbing, and the humour of looking too closely.

title: Piku
blurb: A father, a daughter, and the long road between constipation and care. Domestic, funny, exact.

title: Chashme Buddoor
blurb: Four friends, one crush, and a Delhi that still feels like a neighbourhood. Light on its feet.
